Pendleton County, West Virginia
Notice of Public Hearing on the Ordinance of County Commission of Pendleton County
By The Pendleton Times,
12 hours agoA public hearing will be held on the following entitled Ordinance at a meeting of The County Commission of Pendleton County (the “County Commission”) to be held on Tuesday, July 1, 2025, at 9:00 a.m. in the Pendleton County Courthouse, 100 South Main Street, Franklin, West Virginia, and at such hearing any person interested may appear before the County Commission and present protests, and all protests and suggestions shall be heard by the County Commission and it shall then take such actions as it shall deem proper in the premises upon an Ordinance entitled:
